claims: Adrien Brody is a two-time Academy Award winner for Best Actor.
Adrien Brody won the Academy Award for Best Actor for 'The Pianist' at the 75th Academy Awards in 2002.
Adrien Brody won the Academy Award for Best Actor for 'The Brutalist' at the 97th Academy Awards in 2025.
Adrien Brody's win for 'The Pianist' (2002) made him the youngest winner in the Best Actor category at age 29.
Adrien Brody delivered a 5-minute-plus acceptance speech for his 2025 Best Actor Oscar win.
Adrien Brody attended the 98th Academy Awards in 2026 to present after his 2025 win.
